## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: running the post-processor on a gov-copy-writer draft artifact populates checks.fk_grade, checks.banned_words_found, and checks.active_voice for every item
- dd-2: script overwrites any LLM-supplied check values and records source of each check as deterministic-post-processing
- dd-4: script emits a summary line indicating whether the >= 95% closing threshold is met and exits non-zero when not met

## Description
Implement plugins/dso/scripts/gov_copy_postprocess/__main__.py as CLI. For each item: compute fk_grade, banned_words_found, active_voice. Overwrite checks block (do NOT merge with LLM values). Set checks.source='deterministic-post-processing'. Call deviations.build_deviations preserving author reasons. Write artifact back to disk. Compute pass_ratio. Emit summary line with 'pass_ratio:' and 'closing_threshold_met:'. Exit non-zero when pass_ratio < closing_ratio (from config).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED tests now pass
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k pipeline
- [ ] CLI invocable
  Verify: python -m plugins.dso.scripts.gov_copy_postprocess --help 2>&1 | grep -iE '(usage|artifact)'

## File Impact

On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
